title: smime-tree: VerificationResult struct doc missing 'any-signer' security warning
description: is_verified() has a # Security section about permissive any-signer semantics, but the VerificationResult struct-level doc (lines 8-18 of error.rs) has no such warning. A caller reading the struct type to understand what verify() returns will miss the caveat. Add a # Security note to the struct doc too.
